task_type: shared visual defect repair and QA expansion
requested_outcome: Repair amenity icon geometry across the shared VII detail surfaces and make QQQAAA the durable trigger and executable command for the broadest approved VII QA suite.
natural_destination: VII public place pages and the repository QA command pnpm qa:qqqaaa
authorization_boundary: Repair source and automated QA. Do not publish a new production release without a separate publication authorization. Preserve the existing explicit exclusions for accessibility and typography audits.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared visual defect must expand to the affected component family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The shared icon family is checked across routes, locales and viewports.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every visible icon-label control must remain readable and geometrically valid.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: QA measures SVG containment, centering and icon-label intersection.

lesson_bundle.reason: The same shared family must remain stable on the primary mobile surface.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The matrix includes desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height mobile.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the photographed hourly page is fixed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair the shared semantic icon class and scan every rendered data-feature-icon.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All representative place families and four locales pass icon geometry checks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The icon no longer overlaps but remains visibly off-center.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure the SVG center against its frame, not only CSS declarations.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every visible semantic feature icon stays contained and within the centering tolerance.

predicted_rejections.rejection: QQQAAA is remembered only in this chat and cannot be executed consistently.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Record the trigger in the VII feedback standard and add a single fail-closed package command.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A fresh agent reading the project standard can discover the trigger and pnpm qa:qqqaaa invokes the broad suite.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The broad suite silently includes previously excluded accessibility and typography audits.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve and document the existing exclusions in the trigger contract and report.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The comprehensive report continues to declare those two exclusions.

affected_family: vacation place feature groups and room amenities
localized Hebrew, English, Russian and French place routes
desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height mobile viewports
QQQAAA project trigger and executable QA entry point

midpoint_gate.trigger: The exact hourly page renders with measured icon containment before running the full family.
checks: Hourly place icon geometry passes at desktop and mobile

attack_questions: Can any SVG escape its frame?
Can an icon intersect its label?
Can a long translated label break containment?
Can QQQAAA omit a required existing suite?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Rendered representative place pages and the QQQAAA command output.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Four locales and the desktop, mobile and low-height matrix.

effectiveness.baseline: The supplied hourly desktop screenshot shows semantic amenity icons overlapping their labels.
effectiveness.target: Zero icon containment, centering or label-collision defects in the affected matrix and one durable QQQAAA entry point.
